entities.title: The bubble
entities.summary: The ordered list of at most 13 objects near the player.
entities.purpose: Keeps the bubble (RULES B.9, C.1, C.3.3): the objects, their slots and per-type counts. Adding to a full bubble fails silently; removing shifts later objects down a slot.
boundaries: A capability: it uses no feature or use case (tests/layers.rs).
Where objects are placed, and the station's replacement by the sun, belong to the features that use the bubble.
